festivals.title: APAP Artwork Tour

The Anyang Foundation for Culture & Arts has created a tour program to explore the wonderful works, starting from the earliest works in 2005 up until now.

festivals.title: Gyeonggi Ceramics Biennale
festivals.overview: The Gyeonggi Ceramics Biennale features a range of exhibitions and educational events. The event takes place at various locations in Korea famous for ceramics, including Icheon, Yeoju, and Gwangju.

festivals.title: Han River Walk
festivals.overview: The Han River Walk is a walking event that takes place at various locations along the Hangang River. Participants can expect to enjoy light exercise in beautiful natural settings, as well as earn a completion medal. In addition to walking, the festival dates will feature a range of additional events for a lively environment.

festivals.title: Goyang Autumn Flower Festival
festivals.overview: Goyang Autumn Flower Festival is an annual festival featuring autumn flowers like chrysanthemums, cosmos, sunflowers, and zinnias. VIsitors can enjoy autumn to the fullest with the flowers at their peak in the garden and flower artworks in the indoor exhibition hall. The festival also offers various performances, flower market and traditional experiences.

festivals.title: Seoul Hanok Week
festivals.overview: Seoul Hanok Week is a cultural event held in the Bukchon and Seochon areas, featuring exhibitions, talks, tours, hands-on activities, performances, and other programs that showcase the spaces and appeal of traditional Korean hanok. The event offers various opportunities to experience hanok as part of everyday life through a range of cultural programs.

The festival unfolds across a series of themed programs including romance, science fiction, and fantasy. festivals.title: Icheon Ginseng Festival
festivals.overview: The Icheon Ginseng Festival has been held annually since 2015 to promote the benefits and value of the locally grown ginseng. The festival features sales as well as events.

festivals.title: Jeongdong Culture Festival
festivals.overview: Jeongdong Culture Festival brings an autumn ambience to Jeongdong-gil in Jung-gu, Seoul. The festival aims to promote the attractions within the area through various events and exhibitions.

festivals.title: Gangdong Prehistoric Culture Festival
festivals.overview: Now in its 31st edition, the Gangdong Prehistoric Culture Festival brings Korea's prehistoric past to life in Amsa-dong, Gangdong-gu, Seoul. The festival showcases the Archeological Site in Amsa-dong, one of Seoul’s most important Neolithic heritage sites. It offers visitors a glimpse into daily life in prehistoric Korea and highlights the significance of this period in the country's history. Hands-on activities, exhibitions, performances, and interactive programs offer engaging ways to explore Neolithic culture. festivals.title: Gwanak Gang Gam-chan Festival
festivals.overview: The Gwanak Gang Gam-chan Festival is Seoul's representative historical and cultural festival, held in Gwanak, a city steeped in history, to commemorate the patriotic spirit and achievements of General Gang Gam-chan, the hero of the Battle of Gwiju. It is not only a representative historical and cultural festival of Seoul held to honor the patriotic spirit of the renowned Goryeo general, but also a representative festival of Gwanak-gu created and enjoyed by its residents.

festivals.title: Geumcheon Harmony Festival
festivals.overview: The Geumcheon Harmony Festival is Geumcheon-gu's representative festival, held annually for over 20 years since its inception in 2003. The festival aims to provide a venue for residents to rest, enjoy, and harmonize through the theme of music. Utilizing venues such as Geumnarae Jungang Park and the Plaza in front of the Geumcheon-gu Office, the event is planned to feature content that residents can enjoy and participate in. festivals.title: Dasan Jeong Yak-yong Culture Festival
festivals.overview: The Dasan Jeong Yak-yong Cultural Festival is themed around the life of Jeong Yak-yong (penname Dasan). The festival takes place in the area surrounding the Jeong Yak-yong Historic Site and Dasan Ecological Park. During the festival, various performances and hands-on programs will be prepared for visitors. In addition, busking performances and markets are held at Dasan Ecological Park, and it is a festival where you can experience Jeong Yak-yong's historical and cultural content, performances, and hands-on activities together.

festivals.title: Seoul Silver Grass Festival
festivals.overview: Seoul Silver Grass Festival takes place at Haneul Park. Originally a garbage dump, the land was reformed and transformed into the vibrant, healthy ecosystem it has today in large part thanks to the planting of silver grass. The park now features the largest colony of silver grass found in Seoul, and hosts the Seoul Silver Grass Festival every year in October when the grass is in bloom.

festivals.title: Hangang River Festival

Perfect for walking, running, or relaxing, the Hangang River area is filled with healthy laughter, delicious delights, and sparkling romance. A wonderful day at the Hangang River Festival is completed by applauding the gala show stage, created by aspiring youth and musical stars. festivals.title: Yeoju Ogoknaru Festival
festivals.overview: The 2026 Yeoju Ogoknaru Festival celebrates Yeoju's traditional culture and history, harking back to a time when local specialties such as rice and sweet potatoes were shipped from Jopo Quay as tribute offerings to the royal court during the Joseon dynasty. Highlights include the Royal Tribute Parade, Bibimbap with Cast-Iron-Pot-Cooked Yeoju Rice, Roasted Sweet Potato Guinness, Wish Paper Trail, and Nakhwanori, along with local produce markets, food stalls, traditional cultural activities, and performances. festivals.title: Seoul Petlympics
festivals.overview: The Seoul Petlympics is an urban dog sports festival where citizens and their dogs can run, walk, and take on challenges together to create special memories. Held at Peace Plaza in Seoul World Cup Park, the event features a variety of participatory programs designed so that not only professional athletes but also citizens and their dogs who are new to dog sports can enjoy the experience together. festivals.title: Oh Slow Vintage Market
festivals.overview: Oh Slow Vintage Market is a lifestyle festival where vintage, antique, and second-hand cultures blend together against the backdrop of the historical scenery of Incheon Open Port. Professional vintage sellers from across the country gather to showcase special items containing their unique tastes and stories, including vintage fashion, antique objects, retro accessories, and handicrafts. festivals.title: Korea Grand Sale
festivals.overview: The Korea Grand Sale is Korea’s premier tourism festival for international visitors, combining shopping, culture, and travel. Held during the winter tourism off-season, the event aims to promote travel to Korea by offering a wide range of benefits for international visitors across various sectors, including flights and transportation, shopping, accommodation, food and beverages, beauty and wellness, experiences, and travel services. festivals.title: Vegan & Halal Beauty Fair
festivals.overview: The Vegan & Halal Beauty Fair provides visitors an opportunity to explore beauty brands and products embodying diverse values ​​and standards, including vegan and halal, all in one place. In particular, it provides a special opportunity to encounter and experience new brands and products that are usually difficult to come by, as well as to discover changing beauty trends and the flow of new K-Beauty up close.
